title: Additional religious orders: bounded research and independent cold review, 2026-10-20
semantics: Project-created bibliographic metadata for witnesses, whole books, components, approvals, and leads. Dates keep their attestation, approval, copying, or publication roles. No independent rite recension, textual parentage, local adoption, complete chronology, or redistribution permission is inferred. The retained candidate status 'researched-witness-proposal' describes an evidence-bounded candidate even after metadata integration; 'researched-source-gap' remains an unresolved lead. The independent cold review accepted these metadata rows, not independent recensions or stages.

uses.label: Order of Saint Augustine, Hermits

uses.label: Servants of Mary

uses.label: Order of Mercy

uses.limit: Original 1507 copy and 1560 final folios absent; 1694 identity unresolved.

uses.limit: Earlier originals and direct BNE and Colombina inspections absent.

versions.qualification: OAD rescript authorizes use of the OSA proper with variations. Original OSA approval and precise Mass text are missing.

versions.title: 1975-approved Spanish Augustinian Mass proper; source-language antecedent unresolved
versions.date: Spanish version confirmed 17 May 1975; missal published in Rome in 1976
versions.qualification: Acta OAR 2007, PDF pp. 19–20, reports a revision begun in 1970, confirmation of the Spanish version on 17 May 1975 (Prot. 588/75), and a Rome 1976 missal. versions.evidence_ceiling: Official retrospective attestation of Spanish witness; antecedent source language unresolved; no original book collation

versions.title: Shared Augustinian Latin Proprium Missarum
versions.date: 17 February 2006 approval for OAR; other orders received separate decrees
versions.qualification: Official Acta prints the OAR Latin confirmation and explains joint text sent separately to OSA, OAR and OAD. Complete Latin proper is not acquired.

versions.title: Augustinian Spanish and English Mass proper components
versions.date: 1976 and 2007 Spanish publications; English hub dates unresolved
versions.qualification: Spanish editions and official English sacramentary and lectionary must remain separate components. Their independent translation history is deferred.

versions.title: BAV Pal. lat. 505, Missale Romanum for Servite use
versions.date: second half of the fourteenth century in Heidelberg catalogue; BAV metadata broadly fourteenth to fifteenth century
versions.qualification: The title explicitly names Roman Curia use. Main missal extends through 321rb in the Heidelberg description; only two BAV images acquired.

versions.title: BAV Pal. lat. 505, additional Mass formularies
versions.date: later than main manuscript, exact date unresolved
versions.qualification: Heidelberg catalogue places additions at 321rb–322v. Layer-specific hands, wording and dates remain unexamined.

versions.title: Claimed Servite proper approval and promulgation
versions.date: 1964 dates reported by an unofficial copy
versions.qualification: Original official letter or edition is required before approval on 7 June and promulgation on 16 November can be accepted.

versions.title: Servite Proprium Missarum, volume I, Antiphonale Sacramentarium
versions.qualification: Notitiae distinguishes 6 February 1971 calendar confirmation from the 1 October Mass proper approval. Complete volume not acquired.

versions.title: Servite Proprium Missarum, volume II, Lectionarium
versions.qualification: Bibliography identifies this as a companion to volume I, not a separate recension. Complete volume not acquired.

versions.title: Servite Proprium Missarum editio typica altera, volume I Antiphonale Sacramentarium
versions.qualification: Baroffio AMEN AMEN, PDF p. 230, names volume I of the 1998 second typical edition. The Servite order bibliography names the edition generically. Original front matter and approval remain uninspected.

versions.title: Servite Proprium Missarum editio typica altera, volume II Lectionarium
versions.qualification: Baroffio AMEN AMEN, PDF p. 230, explicitly names volume II Lectionarium in the 1998 second typical edition, Libri Liturgici OSM 1–2 bis. Original volume and approval remain uninspected.

versions.title: German Servite Eigenfeiern Mass proper
versions.qualification: DLI catalogue only; translation relationship and liturgical completeness are unexamined.

versions.title: Unfulfilled Joan Luschner Mercedarian missal contract
versions.qualification: USUARIUM cites Madurell-Rubio documents 240, 242 and 248: 150 copies were contracted but not printed. Never count as a produced edition.

versions.title: First printed Mercedarian missal, catalogue report
versions.qualification: USUARIUM reports a first edition, but no copy, imprint or full text is identified in retained evidence.

versions.title: Missale secundum consuetudinem Ordinis de Mercede, ACA XXVI.1.1
versions.qualification: Only known copy lacks final folios. Barcelona Baies/Bages names need title or colophon inspection for printer versus bookseller role.

versions.title: Missae propriae festorum Ordinis de Mercede, Madrid
versions.qualification: Royal press, [4] plus 36 pages in institutional catalogue. No original object acquired; a proper is not a full missal.

versions.title: ACA XXVI.1.1 bound Mercedarian proper booklet
versions.date: 1641 title-page date in USUARIUM content table
versions.qualification: Catalogue content table images 579–609 records a separately titled 1641 proper after the 1560 missal. Original title image inaccessible; do not date the booklet 1560.

versions.title: Mercedarian missal with proper Masses reported in order history
versions.qualification: Order history calls it first missal with proper Masses, which must not erase 1507 and 1560 full-missal reports or the 1617 proper.

versions.title: Latin Proprium Missarum Ordinis Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede
versions.qualification: Official Notitiae 14 (1978), printed pp. 289–290, names Prot. CD 268/76. Complete Latin book is not acquired.

versions.title: Mercedarian Italian and Spanish Mass propers
versions.qualification: Notitiae names two language editions. These are translation witnesses, not two Latin revisions.

versions.title: BNE MSS/08958, Santiago Order evangeliary
versions.qualification: USUARIUM ID 3000 labels an evangeliary, not a full missal. Order attribution needs direct BNE check.

versions.title: BNE MS 931, Missale Sancti Jacobi associated with Uclés
versions.qualification: Andalusian thesis reports a Roman Curia usage title. BNE catalogue, provenance and text are uninspected.

versions.title: Earlier reformed Santiago Order missal
versions.date: 1536 authorization request; attested in 1541 Uclés inventory
versions.qualification: IEC study cites 11 December 1536 nuncio letter and 1541 inventory. Neither date is proven publication; no exemplar known to that study.

versions.title: Second Santiago Order missal before the 1560 third edition
versions.qualification: IEC study calls 1560 the third edition and says copies of both earlier editions were unknown. Exact second date and text remain open.

versions.title: Santiago Order missal, León, Pedro de Celada
versions.qualification: IEC study identifies a Colombina exemplar and a third edition. Martín Pérez de Ayala correction instrument must be separated from the printing and inspected.

versions.title: Vienna Missae propriae festorum Ordinis Servorum Beatae Mariae Virginis
versions.qualification: OSZK RK 182(3), printed p. 30, catalogues a separately bound proper with Roman missal. No textual revision is inferred.
